import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, 't', 'o', 'Title', 'Body', None),
    (2, 't', 'o', "O'Brien \"x\"", 'B2', None),
    (3, 'other', 'o', 'Cross tenant', 'X', None),
    (4, 't', 'other', 'Cross owner', 'X', None),
    (5, 't', 'o', 'Deleted', 'X', '2026-01-01'),
    (6, 't', "o'x", 'Quoted owner', 'Q', None),
    (7, 't', 'o', 'Later', 'L', None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
c.commit()

assert get_document(c, 't', 'o', 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}
assert get_document(c, 't', 'o', 3) is None
assert get_document(c, 't', 'o', 4) is None
assert get_document(c, 't', 'o', 5) is None
assert get_document(c, 'other', 'o', 1) is None
assert get_document(c, 't', "o'x", 6) == {"id": 6, "title": "Quoted owner", "body": "Q"}
assert get_document(c, 't', 'o', 6) is None
assert get_document(c, "t' OR '1'='1", 'o', 1) is None
assert get_document(c, 't', "o' OR '1'='1", 1) is None

assert list_documents(c, 't', 'o') == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
    {"id": 2, "title": "O'Brien \"x\"", "body": "B2"},
    {"id": 7, "title": "Later", "body": "L"},
]
assert list_documents(c, 't', "o'x") == [{"id": 6, "title": "Quoted owner", "body": "Q"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t' OR '1'='1", 'o') == []
assert list_documents(c, 't', 'missing') == []
assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in list_documents(c, 't', 'o'))
print("security checks passed")
